items.label: MA-AG civil: Sand Canyon (formerly known as Option One)
items.detail: Settlement of AG unfair and discriminatory subprime lending claims against the H&R Block subsidiary; date is the announcement date (filed the day before). Release values the settlement at $125 million: $9.8 million paid to the Commonwealth plus an estimated $115 million in loan modification relief. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 125,000,000 to 9,800,000; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-001.

excluded_amounts.defendant: Sand Canyon (formerly known as Option One)
excluded_amounts.reason: Release: a settlement "valued at $125 million"; Option One will "pay $9.8 million to the Commonwealth" and direct its servicer to run a loan modification program that "will provide an estimated $115 million in additional relief". Counted: the $9.8 million payment. Not counted: the loan modifications (the headline less the payment; the release rounds the relief to $115 million).
excluded_amounts.category_label: Debt relief, loan modification or account credits
